test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully and decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statement:

B ≤ L ≤ U = A > D > E

Conclusions:

I. B < D

II. A ≥ B

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Either conclusion I or II follows

solution:
Given Statement: B ≤ L ≤ U = A > D > E

Now,

Conclusions:

(i) B B ≤ L ≤ U = A > D No relation can be established between B and D)

(ii) A ≥ B → True (B ≤ L ≤ U = A It gives B ≤ A)

Here, Only conclusion II follows .

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
